payload.title: Build a sourced editorial queue and scientific validation
payload.goal: Turn retained candidates into accurate, current and reviewable original explainers.
payload.owner_role: Windows combined release parent / admitted WHB lane
implementation_steps: Quarantine the 13 retained queue entries as unreviewed candidates; bind content ID/version to primary source URLs, retrieval dates, quoted/paraphrased scope, units, assumptions, uncertainty and asset rights. Do not fetch or play remote videos merely to assert old format claims.

Choose one excellent scale explainer plus two next candidates. Recompute comparisons with units/tolerance and distinguish mean/range/context; Earth-Moon spacing and million/billion seconds are candidate topics, not preapproved facts.

Generate original venue-appropriate caption/visual transcript/alt text, accessible typography and source links; move candidate through proposed/sourced/math_checked/editorial_review/approved with reviewer and exact asset hash.
tests: Unit conversion, dimension mismatch, rounded headline, outdated source and misleading analogy fixtures are rejected or corrected.
Every factual claim in the candidate maps to a dated primary source or explicitly labeled inference; missing rights/source blocks approval.
One candidate and two next-ready proposals have readable transcript/alt text and exact source/asset manifests.

review.identity_requirement: A reviewer other than the implementer records actual identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model review when required by the admitted contract. Self-review does not qualify.
review.source_binding: Review exact Git commit and SHA256 manifest of changed source/assets/config; distinguish Windows CRLF worktree bytes from Git blobs. Any repair invalidates affected prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two repair/review attempts per candidate within admitted budget; unresolved failure creates one actionable block and leaves independent work eligible.

acceptance: An independently reviewed accurate explainer is ready without needing account access.
Queue candidates cannot publish on old relative timing alone.
payload.rollback: Disable this capability, retain immutable evidence/receipts, restore the last reviewed source/config version and reconcile attempted external effects before any retry.
payload.next_eligible_action: Designated owner matches the proposed scope to current Jira/source and assigns disjoint paths; then perform implementation step 1. External gates block only the named effects.

estimate.assumptions: New planning estimate, not historical estimate or worklog. Reuse accepted returned implementation where its exact source passes this contract. Excludes elapsed observation windows, account waiting and shared SH implementation.
estimate.dependency_risk: Host/provider/account qualification or conflicting release-worker ownership can delay dependent effects; offline work remains eligible.
